findings.title: Approved test policy watchdog freshness was not attainable in the measured isolated JDBC transport
findings.evidence: 40/40 fresh administrative heartbeat handoffs exceeded actual 100us and approved maximum 200us; minimum 2190us. This is a necessary-predicate experiment, not a full wrapper execution or proof of universal impossibility.
findings.consequence: Positive readiness/claim/E2E and dependent frozen parity, rollback, concurrency and recovery remain unqualified. No policy widening or forged PASS.
findings.next_action: Define and review a separate rehearsal-only fixture amendment using measured bounds, preserve preflight TTL 1000000/max2000000, and rerun positive readiness qualification before dependent gates.

default_acl_effective_type_probe.normative_basis: SPEC 24.2/24.3 preserves intrinsic associated row types and PostgreSQL intrinsic creation behavior; no non-owner operational table/function authority is permitted.

resolved_findings.title: Default-ACL probe requires explicit treatment of PostgreSQL implicit row types
resolved_findings.evidence: All nine owner probes had no schema/table/function PUBLIC grants, and diagnostic confirmed explicit enum owner-only USAGE. Implicit row type and its array report PUBLIC USAGE; enum array effective PUBLIC USAGE is false despite NULL typacl. The raw aclexplode(acldefault) probe alone is insufficient to classify generated types.
resolved_findings.consequence: DEFAULT_ACL_LEAK is HOLD, not NO. No tenant data or executable authority leak was demonstrated; generated-type effective exposure still requires contract classification and targeted checks.
resolved_findings.next_action: Add a targeted public-schema implicit row-type probe with actual service login and distinguish type construction from raw table/function authority; record normative classification before final.
resolved_findings.resolution: Closed by actual four-login public-schema probe and SPEC 24.2/24.3 intrinsic-type rule. Caller constructed (1), never read stored 999. SELECT/UPDATE and creation of explicit-type dependencies all denied 42501. Literal casts are not operational data/function authority.
